column4: cleat#2113. Same class as TestRustExampleEntryPointResolutionLive (rust-toolchain-not-provisioned-in-test-go-commands.tsv): the "commands" job (./cmd/...) provisions no wasm32-unknown-unknown target, so this test's own build hits a missing target and skips via t.Skip after checking `rustup target list --installed` directly (this test cannot use the older substring-on-build-output check -- that check is exactly what a falsification of this test's own regression proved unsafe: it would misclassify a real build failure as "target not installed" and skip past it). Measured: go test ./cmd/cleat/ -run TestRustEntryPointsSurviveARenamedMacroImport -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly one, on a machine/job with cargo but no wasm32-unknown-unknown target.
